interpretation: The reduced research implementation now has a prospectively qualified numerical policy on the six-material 60-day controlled panel.
All measured same-runner process wall ratios are below one; the slowest measured case is GW_LB B05 at approximately 0.275 of R128 wall time.
This is a controlled-harness computational advantage, not a portable Full-SWAP speedup.
Numerical-policy qualification does not remove representation error.

SURF_P: B05 retains 19-day daily storage-extremum timing error.
B06 shows 30-day daily storage-extremum timing error on the 60-day extension workload.
B12 has zero extrema-timing error but material-dependent profile/storage RMSE, including relatively large 0-20 cm storage error.
GW_LB: All P5 six-material 60-day cases have zero sign-mismatch days, zero reversal-sequence mismatch and zero reversal-timing error under the P3 daily forcing.
Short-horizon P2/P2D reversal sensitivity remains part of the known operating error map and is not erased by P5.
